description: SOC Collaboration & Analyst Workflow — workload, SLA breaches, escalations, handoffs, watchlists. No autonomous SOC operations.
title: XDR SOC Collaboration

targets.rawSql: SELECT assigned_to, COUNT(*) AS open_count, MIN(created_at) AS oldest FROM investigations WHERE state NOT IN ('resolved','closed','false_positive') AND assigned_to IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_to ORDER BY open_count DESC
SELECT created_at AS time, breach_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sla_breaches WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', created_at), breach_type ORDER BY time
SELECT created_at AS time, event_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM escalation_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', created_at), event_type ORDER BY time

SELECT investigation_id, title, state, severity, created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - created_at)) / 3600 AS age_hours FROM investigations WHERE state NOT IN ('resolved','closed') ORDER BY age_hours DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM investigations WHERE state NOT IN ('resolved','closed','false_positive')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT escalation_id) AS value FROM escalation_events WHERE event_type = 'created' AND escalation_id NOT IN (SELECT escalation_id FROM escalation_events WHERE event_type = 'resolved')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sla_breaches WHERE acknowledged = false
SELECT created_at AS time, unresolved_count AS value FROM analyst_handoffs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY time
SELECT created_at AS time, watch_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM watchlists WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at), watch_type ORDER BY time
